notes:
Fixes and polish for 10.0.0.

- Page changes are smoother: the old page leaves before the new one arrives, so you no longer see the two at once.
- Removed the clipped glow under the selected filter chips in the Library and the tabs on a game page.
- Fixed the spacing under the toggles in Settings > Look & feel.
- Fixed a hidden error when opening games quickly, and Settings > Updates > Check now getting stuck if the check could not start.
- The Delete and Report boxes in Messages now close with Esc.
- The version number in the introduction and Settings > About now follows the version you are running.
